    // Typed assertion overloads narrow by the overload the call picks.
    declare function chk(v: unknown, tag: string): asserts v is string
    declare function chk(v: unknown, tag: number): asserts v is number
    declare x: unknown
    chk(x, 1)
    local n: number = x
    declare y: unknown
    chk(y, "s")
    local s: string = y

    declare function maybe(v: unknown, tag: number): void

    local z1: string = z
